1. (Currently amended) A multi-layer coating comprising: (a) a color-imparting, non-hiding coating layer deposited from a protective coating composition comprising an aqueous dispersion comprising color-imparting particles stably dispersed in aqueous medium in admixture with one or more polymers, and (b) a clear coat layer deposited over at least a portion of the color-imparting, non-hiding layer, wherein said color-imparting, non-hiding coating layer has a light transmittance of 10 to 95% at a wavelength of 400 to 700 nm in a 15-micron thick cured coating film.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the color-imparting particles are present in the aqueous dispersion in an amount of 0.1 to 50 percent by weight based on total solids present in the aqueous dispersion.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Cancelled)

6. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers contain a functional group that is reactive with a curing agent, wherein the functional group is selected from the group consisting of carboxylic acid groups, epoxy groups, hydroxyl groups, isocyanate groups, amide groups, carbamate groups, carboxylate groups and mixtures thereof.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 6 in which the aqueous dispersion contains a curing agent selected from aminoplasts and polyisocyanates including blocked polyisocyanates.

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers are present in the aqueous dispersion in amounts of 10 to 70 percent by weight based on total weight of solids in the aqueous dispersion.

11. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 wherein the color-imparting particles have an average primary particle size of less than 150 nanometers, wherein said smaller particle size provides improved smoothness, gloss, and distinctness-of-image in the coating.

12. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 applied over a reflective surface comprising a reflective material having a total reflectance of at least 30 percent, wherein the reflective material comprises metallic pigments selected from aluminum, bronze, or copper powders.

13. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 12 wherein the reflective material is a base coat deposited from a coating composition.

14. (Original) A substrate coated with the multi-layer coating of claim 1.

15. (Original) A substrate coated with the multi-layer coating of claim 13.

16. (Currently amended) The multi-layer coating of claim 1 in which the one or more polymers are selected from acrylic polymers, polyester polymers, polyurethane polymers, polyether polymers, including mixtures thereof, wherein the acrylic polymers are formed from polymerizable monomers including (meth)acrylic acid.
